items.note: Aggregate placeholder for webbing, water, rations and small kit until M2.5 itemises it; rifle, magazines, helmet and vest are separate items.
Empty magazine mass published. See docs/research/ballistics.md (values from search extracts of the cited pages).
Helmet mass from the published 1.4 kg requirement; protection against fragments and pistol rounds (game value: 2.5 mm steel equivalent, so square rifle hits penetrate). See docs/research/squads.md.

Hard plates class SK4 (rifle rounds up to 7.62x51) front and back, soft armour SK1 around them. Mass is an estimate (not found); plate coverage of the chest is a game value. See docs/research/squads.md.

Under-barrel 40 mm grenade launcher, about 1.5 kg. The search tool declined these look-ups in the research session; values are from general published references as remembered and must be verified against a public source. Game abstraction.
120-round belt in a soft pouch; links counted in the belt mass; every fifth round tracer. Belt length and pouch mass are game values. Links counted in the empty mass.
20-round polymer magazine (published); mass estimated.
Panzerfaust 3 firing unit with sight, 2.3 kg (search extracts); kept after a shot, it takes the next round (de-pzf3-dm12, a 12.9 kg tube). Firing unit and one round: 15.2 kg as before M7.4a.
Two litres of water in canteens or a bladder. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
One day of rations. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Individual first-aid kit (tourniquet, dressings); used by the medical system in M10. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Load-carrying vest or belt kit, pouches, small pack, weather clothing, tools. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Night-vision goggle; used by sensors in M9. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Section radio with battery, typical mass; the comms model does not read it yet (M14).
30-round STANAG-type magazine for the G95A1; mass typical, not sourced.
The Puma's fuel tank (M7): the charge is litres of diesel (0.84 kg per litre). The tank itself is part of the hull (mass 0). Capacity is a game value.
Ready or stowed belt of 100 armour-piercing 30 mm rounds (Puma: 200 ready in two feeds and as many stowed are game values for the published total).
Ready or stowed belt of 100 high-explosive 30 mm rounds (split of the published total is a game value).
500-round belt for the coaxial MG5, every fifth round tracer (game values).
Game value: one charge of the vehicle's fire extinguishing system (M7.4b).
